decisions.executionNote: Approach the rear-left white support with the left arm, gradually selecting the elbow-up posture; object alignment will be checked before grasping.

Descend above the remaining supports with open fingers, using separate left/right workspaces. Wrist views will determine final grasp corrections.
Align each open gripper to its block's visible long axis, compensating the fingertip offset while gently descending to grasp height.

Close the left fingers on the shorter board. Bring the empty right gripper above the opposite end while smoothly rotating into a matching board grasp.
Finish squaring the right gripper, lower it to the shorter board's end, and close while the left end remains fixed.
Lift the shorter board evenly with both grippers closed, preserving its level orientation and checking retention before transporting it over the middle supports.

Lower the centered middle board slowly and evenly onto the two upright middle supports, keeping both grasps closed until seated.

Replan from the interrupted pose: retract slightly to relieve the nearly folded joint configuration, then raise the retained board in small increments before carrying it over the middle layer.
